text: Two things are new. Event cards now appear only for events the app has checked against the registry, so if a card you expect is missing, tell us what you saw instead of nothing. And a phone that has already picked up an event now passes it on, so try standing away from the beacon next to someone who is already in the event and see whether the card reaches you. Still open from last time: connect a wallet with MetaMask, approve one signature, and confirm the app comes back on its own with the signature applied.
